films.title: THE THIRD MAN in 35mm
films.desc: An American pulp novelist in postwar Vienna finds himself enmeshed in the hunt for an old friend, now a notorious black marketeer.

films.title: A CHRISTMAS CAROL a.k.a. SCROOGE (1951)
sf: FREE for Silver Cinema Club members on Dec. 20
films.desc: Intro and book event with Jeremy Arnold, author of Turner Classic Movies’ “Christmas in the Movies,” on Dec. 20, Dec. 22 and Dec. 23 This 1951 film features Alastair Sim as Ebenezer Scrooge — for many, the definitive performance of the iconic character.

films.desc: Intro and book event with Jeremy Arnold, author of Turner Classic Movies’ “Christmas in the Movies,” on Dec. 19, Dec. 23 and Dec.

films.title: MUPPET TREASURE ISLAND
films.desc: Robert Louis Stevenson’s classic swashbuckling adventure receives a rollicking retelling courtesy of the Muppets. Jim Hawkins (Kevin Bishop) is a scrappy young orphan who gets his hands on a treasure map, taking his best friends Rizzo and Gonzo along for an epic journey to find the booty.

films.title: BLAST OF SILENCE
films.desc: Intro and book event with Jeremy Arnold, author of Turner Classic Movies’ “Christmas in the Movies,” on Dec. 20 Celebrate the holidays in proper noir style with one of the bleakest films ever set during the Christmas season!

films.title: THE NIGHTMARE BEFORE CHRISTMAS
films.desc: Produced and conceived by Tim Burton, Henry Selick’s stop-motion animated musical fantasy is deep, dark and timelessly brilliant.

films.title: CASH ON DEMAND
films.desc: Intro and book event with Jeremy Arnold, author of Turner Classic Movies’ “Christmas in the Movies,” on Dec. 19 and Dec.

films.title: SPIRITED AWAY
films.desc: [SEN TO CHIHIRO NO KAMIKAKUSHI] [千と千尋の神隠し] Teeming with mythical beasts and complex characters, Hayao Miyazaki’s masterpiece won the Golden Bear at the 2002 Berlin Film Festival and the Academy Award® for Best Animated Feature and held the record for the highest-grossing film in Japan’s history…

films.title: HUNDREDS OF BEAVERS: A NORTHWOODS CHRISTMAS
films.desc: One of the unlikeliest independent success stories of the 2020s, this comedy is a “dam” fine time at the movies.

films.title: Best of the 48 Hour Film Holiday Project
films.desc: Come see the winning short films from this year's 48 Hour Film Holiday Project, all made by local filmmakers in just 48 hours! Awards will be given in a number of categories, culminating in Best Film. Approx. runtime: 150 min.For more information, visit 48hourfilm.com

films.title: HOME ALONE
films.desc: Intro and book event with Jeremy Arnold, author of Turner Classic Movies’ “Christmas in the Movies,” on Dec. 20 and Dec.

films.title: AONTAS
sf: Q&A w/ filmmaker Damian McCann, moderated by Maedhbh Mc Cullagh, Director, Capital Irish Film Festival, on Dec. 6
films.desc: Three unlikely thieves, led by a middle-aged woman on the verge of a breakdown, rob the local credit union in their town. Opening in the tragic aftermath of the heist-gone-wrong, a reverse chronology unravels the events that led to this point.

films.title: DUNE: PART THREE in 70mm
sf: DUNE: PART THREE in 70mm Insider Screening: Tue, Dec. 15
films.desc: Directed by Denis Villeneuve, and written by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, DUNE: PART THREE is based on the novel “Dune Messiah” by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

films.title: CAMERON WINTER AT CARNEGIE HALL in 35mm
films.desc: Cameron Winter, in December 2025, after a months-long sold-out tour with his band Geese, returned to New York to play a show at Carnegie Hall. One night only. This is the movie, directed and shot on 35mm and 16mm by Oscar®-winning filmmaker Paul Thomas Anderson (ONE BATTLE AFTER ANOTHER).

films.title: FATHERLAND
films.desc: Set during the height of the Cold War, FATHERLAND centers on the relationship between the writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller) — actress, writer and rally driver — as they embark on a road trip in a black Buick cruiser across a Germany in ruins, from…

films.title: ALICE IN WONDERLAND (1951)
films.desc: “Curioser and curioser.” A listless young girl, Alice, follows a waistcoat-clad White Rabbit down a hole into a fantastical world filled with talking playing cards, a Cheshire Cat sporting a wicked smile, a Mad Hatter and March Hare, a hookah-smoking Caterpillar and much more in Walt Disney’s…

films.title: THE HOLE (1998) in 35mm
films.desc: Set just prior to the start of the 21st century, this vaguely futuristic story follows two residents of a quickly crumbling building who refuse to leave their homes in spite of a virus that has forced the evacuation of the area.

films.title: LOTR: THE FELLOWSHIP OF THE RING in 35mm
films.desc: The future of Middle-earth rests on the fate of the One Ring, which has been lost for centuries.
films.note: 35mm print from the Chicago Film Society.

films.title: BEING HEUMANN
sf: All screenings presented with open captions. Select open-audio description and sensory-friendly screenings offered.
films.desc: They wouldn’t take Judy Heumann’s phone calls, so she took their building. In 1977, a young disabled woman (Ruth Madeley) and a scrappy coalition of outsiders decide they have had enough.

films.title: THE BLOOD COUNTESS
films.desc: [DIE BLUTGRÄFIN] Isabelle Huppert is the infamous serial killer and vampire Countess Elizabeth Báthory in cult filmmaker Ulrike Ottinger’s eye-popping camp masterpiece.

films.title: THE LONELIEST MAN IN TOWN
films.desc: The Italian-Austrian directing duo of Tizza Covi and Rainer Frimmel (LA PIVELLINA) return with this fictionalized portrait of real-life Austrian blues musician Al Cook (a.k.a.

films.title: COWARD
films.desc: Arriving at the Western Front two years into the First World War, stoic Belgian farmhand Pierre (Emmanuel Macchia) is determined to prove his mettle. But the horrific realities of battle bear little resemblance to the heroic ideals he has inherited.

films.title: LE FAUX SOIR
films.desc: Filmmaker Michaël R. Roskam dramatizes the true story of daring resistance by members of the Belgian underground, who risked their lives in November 1943 to print a fake issue of Le Soir, the country’s leading daily newspaper, that ridiculed their Nazi occupiers.

films.title: HEYSEL 85
films.desc: In this film based on true events, writer/director Teodora Ana Mihai recreates the events and aftermath of the Heysel Stadium disaster that took place on May 29, 1985 in Brussels, Belgium, during the European Cup final between Liverpool and Juventus.

films.title: BLACK MONEY FOR WHITE NIGHTS
films.desc: [Черни пари за бели нощи] [CHERNI PARI ZA BELI NOSHTI] Marina and Gosha are a middle-aged Bulgarian couple who have learned how to work the angles in a society where nearly everyone seems to be on the take.

films.title: THE DREAMED ADVENTURE
films.desc: [DAS GETRÄUMTE ABENTEUER] Winner of the Cannes Jury Prize, THE DREAMED ADVENTURE is filmmaker Valeska Grisebach’s gangster epic on the bleeding edge of Europe.

films.title: GOD WILL NOT HELP
films.desc: [BOG NECE POMOCI] In the remote hills of early 20th-century Croatia, a mysterious Chilean woman named Teresa (filmmaker Manuela Martelli, THE MELTDOWN) appears. She has traveled across oceans to reach a solitary farmhouse, where she is greeted with hostility by Milena (Ana Marija Veselčić).

films.title: HOLD ONTO ME
films.desc: [Κράτα Με] Left mostly to her own devices, 11-year-old Iris (Maria Petrova) has built up a tough exterior. Her father left when she was just a baby, and her mother is more interested in her new boyfriend than watching after her unruly daughter.

films.title: IF PIGEONS TURNED TO GOLD
films.desc: [KDYBY SE HOLUBI PROMĚNILI VE ZLATO] Have you ever mourned someone who is still alive?” Filmmaker Pepa Lubojacki poses this question in their feature debut, a raw, uncompromising look over the course of five years at their relationship with their brother and two cousins who struggle with alcoholism…

films.title: THE GUEST
films.desc: [GÆSTEN] In Mads Mengel’s whip-smart debut, which won the Special Jury and Best Director awards at the Karlovy Vary International Film Festival, a seaside family gathering becomes a reckoning with the past when an estranged mother arrives at her grandson’s naming celebration.

films.title: ALL OF A SUDDEN
sf: Pre-screening toast sponsored by Alliance Française of Washington, DC
films.desc: Advance tickets for the Opening Night screening of ALL OF A SUDDEN are currently sold out. At approximately 6:00 p.m. on Wed, Dec. 2, a standby line will form outside AFI Silver; any remaining seats will be made available just before the 6:30 showtime.

films.title: BURGUNDY
films.desc: Documentarians Michael Dweck and Gregory Kershaw (THE TRUFFLE HUNTERS, GAUCHO GAUCHO) blur the boundaries of nonfiction with this delectably whimsical portrait of the titular viticultural region of France and the eccentric characters behind some of the world’s most celebrated wines.

films.title: DE GAULLE - PART ONE: RÉSISTANCE
films.desc: [DE GAULLE: L'ÂGE DE FER] [DE GAULLE: TILTING IRON] A box-office hit in France, Antonin Baudry’s epic two-part biopic on Charles de Gaulle stars Simon Abkarian as de Gaulle and Simon Russell Beale as Winston Churchill.

films.title: DE GAULLE - PART TWO: LIBERTÉ
films.desc: [DE GAULLE: J'ÉCRIS TON NOM] [DE GAULLE: THE SOVEREIGN EDGE] Part Two of Antonin Baudry’s epic biopic on Charles de Gaulle, wonderfully played by Simon Abkarian, sees the leader of the Free French make a triumphant return to France with the D-Day invasion and ride on to Paris; outfox his political…

films.title: FLESH AND FUEL
films.desc: [DU FIOUL DANS LES ARTÈRES] For veteran French trucker Étienne, life on the road has left little room for intimacy beyond fleeting sexual encounters at highway rest stops.

films.title: A MAN OF HIS TIME
films.desc: [NOTRE SALUT] Writer/director Emmanuel Marre takes an unconventional approach to this biopic on an unconventional subject.

films.title: EVERYTIME
films.desc: Six years after the festival tour for her award-winning feature THE TROUBLE WITH BEING BORN was truncated by the COVID pandemic, filmmaker Sandra Wollner returns unimpeded with her third feature, EVERYTIME, which won the top prize in Cannes’ Un Certain Regard section.

films.title: I'LL BE GONE IN JUNE
films.desc: In Katharina Rivilis’ evocative debut, produced by Wim Wenders, a German teenager's year abroad unfolds amid the vast deserts of New Mexico and the upheaval of September 2001.

films.title: TRIAL OF HEIN
films.desc: [DER HEIMATLOSE] German writer/director Kai Stänicke’s impressive debut feature follows the titular Hein, who returns from the mainland to the windswept, fiercely insular island village he left behind as a teenager, determined to reunite with his first love.

films.title: YELLOW LETTERS
films.desc: [GELBE BRIEFE] Turkish-German filmmaker İlker Çatak (THE TEACHERS’ LOUNGE, AFI FEST 2023) returns with this thought-provoking allegory about art and authoritarianism, winner of the Golden Bear at the 2026 Berlin Film Festival.

films.title: BROKEN VEIN
films.desc: [ΣΠΑΣΜΈΝΗ ΦΛΈΒΑ] [SPASMENI FLEVA] Thomas, a middle-aged businessman (Vasilis Bisbikis, BALLAD FOR A PIERCED HEART), spirals out of control when a ruthless loan shark threatens to take his family home.

films.title: GROUND FLOOR
films.desc: [FÖLDSZINT] A well-intentioned yet deadened office drone, Kristóf (Ádám Tompa, BLUE HERON) is distracted, rushing to get ready for his long-awaited summer vacation with his wife, Vera (Bettina Jósza).

films.title: THE ECHO CHAMBER
films.desc: In a richly appointed and gorgeously curated London flat, Leo (Luca Marinelli, MARTIN EDEN) lives a hard-partying lifestyle as a music producer. Suffering from chronic back pain, he is in need of relief and calls for a doctor to make a house visit.

films.title: HOW TO DIVORCE DURING THE WAR
films.desc: [SKYRYBOS KARO METU] Vilnius, 2022. High-flying executive Marija (Žygimantė Elena Jakštaitė) chooses the worst possible moment to inform her husband, Vytas (Marius Repšys), she wants a divorce: just one day before Russia’s invasion of Ukraine.

films.title: WOMEN AS LOVERS
films.desc: [LIEBHABERINNEN] Brigitte, a trade-fair hostess struggling to pay off her debt, becomes entranced by Paula, a young camgirl longing to escape her provincial town. Brigitte, who is nearing middle age, cannot help but compare her own femininity and desirability to Paula.

films.title: ZEJTUNE
films.desc: After the passing of her mother, Mar (Michaela Farrugia) inherits three plots of land across Malta; selling them might finally give her the means to move to the mainland. But her mother’s family have their own plans for the land, so Mar must quickly locate the plots and stake her claim in person.

films.title: PAIKAR
films.desc: Dutch-Afghan filmmaker Dawood Hilmandi returns to confront his estranged father, a former mujahideen fighter turned imam, writer and poet, in a poetic and deeply human search for love, forgiveness, and understanding.

films.title: CLOSURE
films.desc: In his powerful documentary, which debuted at the Sundance Film Festival, Polish filmmaker Michał Marczak (ALL THESE SLEEPLESS NIGHTS) transforms a father’s desperate search for his missing son into a haunting meditation on grief, obsession and the human need to make sense of the inexplicable.

films.title: WILD, WILD EAST
films.desc: [DZIKI, DZIKI WSCHÓD] During the frigid winter of 1943, mysterious Nazi officer Martin Wolff (Itay Tiran) rides into the remote German-occupied Polish village of Zalesie Małe, tasked with a secret mission: investigate the disappearance of a lawyer who had ties to a stockpile of gold that belonged…

films.title: THE DIARY OF A CHAMBERMAID
films.desc: [LE JOURNAL D’UNE FEMME DE CHAMBRE] Filmmaker Radu Jude (KONTINENTAL ’25, AFI European Union Film Showcase 2025), enfant terrible of the Romanian New Wave, returns with another scathing satire, loosely adapting Octave Mirbeau’s novel into an even more provocative metatextual treatise on class and…

films.title: FLOOD
films.desc: [POTOPA] During the 1980s in eastern Czechoslovakia, the impending construction of the Starina reservoir threatens the small Rusyn village of Ruské, its residents and their way of life.

films.title: FANTASY
films.desc: On the outskirts of Ljubljana, a trio of 20-something tomboys struggle to break free from the chains of racism and misogyny in filmmaker Kukla’s stylish and bold coming-of-age tale. Mihrije (Sarah Al Saleh) is desperate to avoid the marriage arranged by her conservative parents.

films.title: THE BELOVED
sf: Post-screening reception sponsored by the Embassy of Spain on Dec. 11
films.desc: [EL SER QUERIDO] In the latest from Spanish filmmaker Rodrigo Sorogoyen (THE BEASTS), Javier Bardem gives an outstanding and frightening performance as a legendary Spanish filmmaker, Esteban Martínez, who returns to Spain to shoot his next picture: a period piece set in 1930s Western Sahara.

films.title: IVÁN & HADOUM
films.desc: Winner of the Teddy Award for films with LGBTQIA+ themes at the Berlinale, as well as two Silver Biznagas at the Málaga Film Festival, Spanish filmmaker Ian de la Rosa’s feature debut follows Iván (Silver Chicón), a forklift driver at a small-town greenhouse who is on the path to becoming a…

films.title: LA BOLA NEGRA in 35mm
films.desc: Drawing inspiration from an unfinished work by Federico García Lorca, beloved Spanish filmmaking duo Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi (known fondly in Spain as Los Javis) craft an expansive, exuberant and visually stunning epic that traces the intertwined histories of political oppression and queer…

films.title: ADULT SUPERVISION
films.desc: [ARKIPELAG] At a parent-teacher night meeting, three men volunteer as chaperones for a school trip to a remote island: nebbish and twitchy Bill (Gustaf Skarsgård, OPPENHEIMER), confident and natural leader Bobo (Fares Fares, EAGLES OF THE REPUBLIC, 2025 AFI European Union Film Showcase) and relaxed…

films.title: BUNKER
films.desc: Academy Award® winners Javier Bardem and Penélope Cruz square off in this marital thriller from acclaimed filmmaker Florian Zeller.

films.title: GROWTH OF THE SOIL
films.desc: [MARKENS GRØDE] The 1917 novel that won Norwegian writer Knut Hamsun the Nobel Prize in Literature is turned into an equally epic film that tells a tale of rural hardship, desire and the passage of time.

films.title: IN BRUGES
films.desc: Playwright Martin McDonagh made his feature directorial debut with IN BRUGES, translating his crackling dialogue and dark humor to the big screen in the story of two hitmen sent to lay low in the Belgian city as penance after newbie Ray (Colin Farrell) botches a hit.

films.title: MY UNDESIRABLE FRIENDS: PART II - EXILE (Ch. 4-5)
films.desc: A group of young journalists deemed “foreign agents” flee Moscow on a moment’s notice when Putin shuts down all independent media, part of a historic exodus of Russians opposed to the war.
